readings.title: Comparing representational geometries using whitened unbiased-distance-matrix similarity
facts: Independent repeat estimates of the SAME condition patterns permit dropping self-products to remove squared-distance noise bias.
Under the stated matrix-normal assumptions, the noise-noise variance contribution is larger by M/(M-1) for the unbiased estimator.
The paper compares representational dissimilarity matrices; it does not derive NLP attention routing or multiclass CE/Macro gains.
transfer_limits: Only these pages inspected; remaining pages,methods proofs and code unread.
Our alternating tokens are different contextualized observations rather than repeated independent estimates of each same latent quantity.
No factor-two variance claim for our model; no identified noise covariance or data-source transfer.

readings.title: Consistent Multiclass Algorithms for Complex Performance Measures
facts: General multiclass metrics can be written as functions of a confusion matrix; Table1 includes macro F1.
Under the explicit differentiability,monotonicity and distribution conditions, optimal classifiers relate to a loss matrix formed from the metric gradient at an optimal confusion matrix.
The stated efficient algorithm instantiations target concave or ratio-of-linear metrics; arbitrary macro F1 is not automatically certified by either shortcut.
transfer_limits: Read scope only pp1-4; algorithm proofs/experiments/supplement/code unread.
Our fixed positive39 excludes class0 and includes absent classes with zeroF1; do not substitute the paper full-n average or micro F1.
Current short repeated development data do not certify consistency,calibration or an independent optimum.
